features.name: Installer & lifecycle
features.description: One command installs, configures, starts, updates and reports the single-container instance (provider, port, projects folder, data dir).
features.fix: P0: `--admin-user/--admin-password` are written to the env file but ignored by the running image; a placeholder `admin` is created and the first password typed claims it. Honour the installer account, or generate a one-time setup token, then test the exact install command. Also make the release build use the release tag instead of a stale `latest`.

features.name: First-run wizard
features.description: Guided first run: workspace/company basics, discovered projects, AI model, git identity and a review step before the product unlocks.
features.fix: P0: `GET /api/companies/onboarding` returns 404 on the published image because `/companies/{company_id}` shadows it; the client gate can never open. Rebuild the image from the release commit and declare the onboarding route before the dynamic one. Add git name/email and provider to the wizard. Merge the two default companies created at boot.

features.name: Login, session & password
features.description: Username-or-email login, signed session cookie, password change and admin-only account administration.
features.fix: P0: on a fresh public install the seeded `admin` has no credential and the first password typed becomes the admin password. Require the installer password or a one-time setup token, and force a password change after the first login. (Creating additional users is covered by `multi-user`, hidden in 0.0.1.)

features.name: Workspace shell & navigation
features.description: Top-level shell that resolves the default workspace, links projects and exposes the project workspace at a stable URL.
features.fix: Reduce the shell to the 0.0.1 set. The project workspace currently opens the Follow-up task list, not a chat, and its sidebar lists 20+ apps (Harness, Messenger, Meet, Coworking, CISO, Infrastructure, Coder, Desktop, Traefik); make the project the default landing (drop the 'Advanced view' wording) and keep New chat, Tasks, Files, Git and Settings. Hide the other company sections through the feature registry, rename 'Company' to 'Workspace', and fix the duplicate default company (two `ACME`, both `is_default`) plus the `counts.humans = 0` inconsistency.

features.name: Project import & switching
features.description: Import an existing folder or clone a Git repository, configure its settings, switch the active project and keep its knowledge fresh.
features.fix: P0/P1: a project created through `POST /api/projects` is absent from `GET /api/projects` until the container restarts (discovery cache is not invalidated). Invalidate the snapshot or force a rescan after create/clone. Write `.codx/` into `.git/info/exclude` on project creation: the first commit currently includes `.codx/db`, chat turns and locks. Create an initial commit and configure the Git identity.

features.name: Chat with the agent
features.description: Project-aware conversation with the agent: modes, profiles, attachments, streaming, tool calls, cancellation and history.
features.fix: P0: with no model configured, `POST /api/chats` returns 200 and the user message alone; nothing tells the user the turn never ran. Validate the provider/model before the turn and return `409 model_required` (or render a blocking 'Connect a model' card). Exercise the full turn with a real provider before release.

features.name: Agent tool loop
features.description: The agent reads and patches files, searches the repo, runs commands/tests, fetches pages and can create tasks or sub-chats.
features.fix: Not exercised end-to-end without a provider key. Before 0.0.1: verify file read/write/patch, terminal, test run and web fetch against a real model; render every tool call and result in the chat; make destructive commands require confirmation; add a per-turn step limit and a clear failure state.

features.name: Agent team & profiles
features.description: A team of role-specific agents (PM, developer, QA, security) with their own instructions, tools and model; a task picks a role and the shared board carries the handoff.
features.fix: P1: the built-in team catalogue and per-task profile selection work (verified). Make the role picker obvious in chat/task creation, show the profile on every task card and document the default team (PM, developer, QA, security). Human multi-user teams remain hidden until the create-user flow works.

features.name: Knowledge (RAG) index
features.description: Index the project into embedded LanceDB and retrieve relevant files and documents before the agent answers.
features.fix: P1: after creating a project the collection is created but stays at `row_count: 0` with 3 files pending; nothing tells the user indexing never started. Pick a working default embeddings model (the image ships the local embeddings stack), start indexing after project creation, and show progress plus a retry/error state.

features.name: Vibe coding view
features.description: Conversation, live file changes and the running app preview side by side so the user can watch the agent build.
features.fix: Keep the chat + diff panes; the preview depends on a dev workspace that 0.0.1 hides. Degrade gracefully to a 'start a workspace' link instead of an empty frame, and verify the diff pane refreshes after every tool write.

features.name: File explorer & viewer
features.description: Browse the project tree, open a file read-only and jump to it from a chat reference without leaving the workspace.
features.fix: P2: verify it is rooted at the project (not the host), hides `.codx`, secrets and binaries, and opens files referenced in chat. Add a large-file guard and a read-only default.

features.name: Shared team board & tasks
features.description: The team's shared queue: every card is a task/chat with a role, priority, checklist and the agent run that produced the change.
features.fix: P1: creating a task succeeds and it appears in `GET /api/tasks`, but `GET /api/tasks/boards` stays empty and a new chat shows up as a task with `status: ""`. Bootstrap a default board/column, normalise the initial status to `todo`, and decide whether a plain chat is a task (the current conflation makes both lists noisy).

features.name: Git & code review
features.description: Branch list, status, staged/unstaged changes, file and PR diffs, commit, pull/push, merge/conflict helpers and GitHub issues.
features.fix: P0: the first commit fails with 'Author identity unknown' until a Git identity is configured; the wizard never asks for it. P1: `GET /api/git/repo/commits` and `/git/repo/branch/commits` return `[]` while `/git/repo/graph` lists the same commit; fix the commit-list query and add a contract test. Prevent `.codx/` from being committed.

features.name: Global & project settings
features.description: Providers, models per purpose, Git identity, environment variables, knowledge options, scripts, preview URL, MCP and per-project permissions.
features.fix: P1: the global settings endpoints return 500 on a project-less fresh install; make sections independent of the project session. The AI Models screen is the only path to make the product usable and it opens empty with a single 'Add new provider' link; seed a one-click provider preset (DeepSeek/OpenAI) and link to it from the no-model chat. Verify save/reload/history.

features.name: REST & Socket.IO API
features.description: The FastAPI surface under `/api` (527 documented paths), Socket.IO events and the OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
features.fix: P2: the OpenAPI document is the de-facto contract, but route ordering leaks (`/companies/onboarding` parsed as an id), errors mix 200-with-error and 4xx, and `/api/features` does not exist. Add the feature endpoint, standardise errors, and publish a small, versioned 'core' subset for 0.0.1 instead of advertising every experimental router.

features.name: Mobile shell
features.description: Purpose-built phone/tablet shell with a tab bar, launcher and full-screen routes; desktop keeps the sidebar/dockview shell.
features.fix: Low risk. Re-check the tab bar and launcher after hidden features are removed; they must not link to a hidden section or an empty screen. Add a visual smoke test for one phone viewport.

features.name: Themes & languages
features.description: DaisyUI themes, dark/light switching, per-user language and the company-shell translations.
features.fix: None for 0.0.1. Keep as-is and ensure hidden sections do not leave untranslated nav keys.

features.name: Suggested replies
features.description: The model offers likely answers as buttons instead of forcing the user to type.
features.hide_reason: Nice-to-have, model-dependent, not part of the first-run 'wow' path.
features.fix: Not in 0.0.1. Before enabling: verify the button payloads round-trip as normal messages and do not leak hidden reasoning.

features.name: Users, roles & invites
features.description: Admin/user roles, project permissions, GitHub OAuth, wallets and spending limits per user.
features.hide_reason: 0.0.1 is a single-developer release; human invites/roles need the create-user fix. The AI team uses profiles and needs no extra accounts.
features.fix: Not in 0.0.1. Before enabling: add an admin-only create-user endpoint (username, email, password, role, project grants) and tests; today `PUT /api/users` requires the body username to equal the caller, so a new account is rejected with 500.

features.name: Budget & cxjcoins
features.description: Wallets, spending limits, cxjcoin pricing per model and per-user budgets.
features.hide_reason: Not needed to prove the core loop; pricing tables are empty on a fresh install.
features.fix: Not in 0.0.1. Before enabling: seed a documented price list, show the cost of the current turn, and fail closed when a limit is exceeded.

features.name: Usage analytics
features.description: Token, call and cost dashboards by user, project and model, plus decision and chat-session logs.
features.hide_reason: Support/ops surface, not a 0.0.1 developer feature.
features.fix: Not in 0.0.1. Before enabling: verify every chart has data after a real AI turn and that `/api/analytics/*` never 500s on an empty database.

features.name: Workspaces (dev containers)
features.description: Docker Compose dev containers with VS Code, a virtual desktop and the app's preview published through Traefik.
features.hide_reason: Requires the Docker socket and is the highest-risk surface for a first release.
features.fix: Not in 0.0.1. This is the first 0.1 feature: require `--coworking`, ship one known-good template, test create/start/stop/preview on a clean host, and remove the dead default workspace from a project-less install.

features.name: Coworking machines
features.description: Whole Linux desktops, Windows/macOS VMs and remote VNC/SSH machines shared by the user and the AI.
features.hide_reason: Depends on Docker privileges; not a 0.0.1 promise.
features.fix: Not in 0.0.1. Before enabling: threat-model the socket mount, add session quotas, and verify the control lease.

features.name: Browser use & co-browsing
features.description: One Chromium page shared by the user (live view) and the AI (CDP tools).
features.hide_reason: Needs the Docker socket and Chromium images; demo value is lower than the core repo loop.
features.fix: Not in 0.0.1. Before enabling: verify browser sessions on a host without a pre-pulled image and add a hard 'no socket' error.

features.name: Computer use
features.description: Desktop/VM sessions with live view, screenshots, control leases, recordings and scripts.
features.hide_reason: Experimental, privileged and heavy.
features.fix: Not in 0.0.1. Before enabling: define the security boundary and cost controls, then test one image end to end.

features.name: Desktop window manager
features.description: A window manager inside the browser where chats, apps, boards and settings open as tabs/windows with saved layouts.
features.hide_reason: Alternative shell that multiplies UI surface; keep the single workspace shell for 0.0.1.
features.fix: Not in 0.0.1. Before enabling: verify layout persistence and that every panel is reachable from the simple shell.

features.name: @codx file mentions
features.description: Write `@codx` in any project file and the background worker edits, explains or improves it in place.
features.hide_reason: Background watcher + write-in-place is hard to explain in a five-minute demo.
features.fix: Not in 0.0.1. Before enabling: debounce, a visible diff/undo, and a per-project opt-in.

features.name: Wiki
features.description: AI-maintained documentation site generated from the project and kept up to date in the background.
features.hide_reason: A wiki is not created by default and generation needs a model; not core to the first demo.
features.fix: Not in 0.0.1. Before enabling: add a 'Create wiki' action, generate the first pages from the project, and show a clear state when no wiki model is configured.

features.name: Company business dashboard
features.description: Revenue, margin, pipeline and business KPIs for the company.
features.hide_reason: This is the 'shapeless' company-OS surface, not a developer tool.
features.fix: Not in 0.0.1. Keep the code; revisit only when the AI-cofounder product line is funded.

features.name: Company tickets
features.description: Cross-project delivery tickets with unattended runs, review and a ledger of each delivery.
features.hide_reason: Autonomous delivery is not reliable enough to demo; kanban covers planning in 0.0.1.
features.fix: Not in 0.0.1. Before enabling: run the full ticket lifecycle against a real repo and reconcile the docs (`/api/companies/{id}/tickets`) with the actual `/api/tickets` route.

features.name: Company assistant
features.description: The company's own chat with starter prompts, streaming, tools, voice and role-aware permissions.
features.hide_reason: A second assistant next to the project chat creates the 'which chat?' confusion 0.0.1 must remove.
features.fix: Not in 0.0.1. Before enabling: one entry point, shared history and a clear scope difference from project chats.

features.name: Company files & coworking spaces
features.description: Company-owned storage plus read-only virtual folders for every linked project and mapped host folder.
features.hide_reason: Overlaps the file explorer and needs the workspace backend.
features.fix: Not in 0.0.1. Before enabling: folder permission tests and a clear 'project vs company' file model.

features.name: CISO & security posture
features.description: Security score, scans, findings, detector rules, policy and the gate journal.
features.hide_reason: Valuable later, but it adds a whole workflow and no scan has run on a fresh install.
features.fix: Not in 0.0.1. Before enabling: run a scan on a real repo, seed the policy, and gate commits with an explicit 'security review' step.

features.name: Teams & messenger
features.description: Teams, categories, channels and DMs shared by humans and agents, with a generated team from a plain-language need.
features.hide_reason: This is the human multi-user team (invites, channels, messenger). The AI agent team ships in 0.0.1 via profiles + the shared board; human teams are 0.1.
features.fix: Not in 0.0.1. Before enabling: fix admin create-user, then test a two-human channel with one agent and the review handoff.

features.name: Company meetings
features.description: Live calls with people and profiles: transcript, recording, minutes and tasks created from the meeting.
features.hide_reason: Experimental media stack, not a developer release feature.
features.fix: Not in 0.0.1. Before enabling: verify WebRTC/transcription on a clean host and the recording consent flow.

features.name: Calendar & scheduling
features.description: Project calendars, events, quick scheduling and snooze for scheduled runs.
features.hide_reason: Support surface for meetings/agents; not core.
features.fix: Not in 0.0.1. Before enabling: verify the scheduled-task integration and timezone handling.

features.name: Autonomous agents (actors)
features.description: Profiles with initiative that take shifts, schedule follow-ups and work inside a weekly availability window.
features.hide_reason: High-risk autonomy; a bad first impression for a new user.
features.fix: Not in 0.0.1. Before enabling: hard budget/step limits, a pause switch, a full audit trail and a supervised 'propose only' mode.

features.name: Autonomous tickets
features.description: Cross-project requests that the target project works end to end (dive, implement, test, validate) until the gate is green.
features.hide_reason: Depends on autonomous agents plus the ticket lifecycle; both hidden.
features.fix: Not in 0.0.1. Before enabling: one supervised end-to-end run with a green QA gate and a rollback path.

features.name: Channel content creator
features.description: Generate video, short, podcast, wiki, slides or a document from a brief and source material.
features.hide_reason: Marketing content generation, not a developer feature.
features.fix: Not in 0.0.1. Before enabling: verify each format's build pipeline and the media storage quota.

features.name: External actors & outreach
features.description: Ask people outside the platform questions from a task, with a global directory and email/manual relay.
features.hide_reason: Email deliverability and consent are whole products; MVP only.
features.fix: Not in 0.0.1. Before enabling: define consent, rate limits and a reply audit.

features.name: Slack & WhatsApp channels
features.description: Mirror external Slack and WhatsApp conversations into codx-junior channels.
features.hide_reason: Design only; no runtime integration exists.
features.fix: Not in 0.0.1. Do not advertise until the integration is implemented and documented.

features.name: Voice conversation
features.description: Talk to codx-junior, hear the answer and keep every turn in the chat, including meeting speech.
features.hide_reason: Stereo/mic permissions and latency make it a poor first demo on unknown hardware.
features.fix: Not in 0.0.1. Before enabling: test on Chrome/Firefox/Safari with a real mic and add a text fallback.

features.name: Plugins
features.description: Load Python plugins that add UI and API behaviour from a file.
features.hide_reason: Arbitrary code execution before the core is stable.
features.fix: Not in 0.0.1. Before enabling: sandboxing, a signature/allow-list and a review of the plugin store.

features.name: MCP connections
features.description: Project-scoped Model Context Protocol servers (CRM, helpdesk, billing, custom APIs) granted to profiles.
features.hide_reason: Strong dev value but adds a configuration surface and a security review; 0.1 headline.
features.fix: Not in 0.0.1. Before enabling: connection test, tool discovery, per-profile grants and a clear secrets story.

features.name: Image generation & vision
features.description: Generate images, analyse screenshots and attach images to chats.
features.hide_reason: Depends on a vision/image model that a fresh install does not have.
features.fix: Not in 0.0.1. Before enabling: provider capability detection and a clear 'no image model' state.

features.name: Log viewer & API monitoring
features.description: Tail, filter and inspect API/agent logs, request traces and the log explorer.
features.hide_reason: Support tool; useful after the core loop is stable.
features.fix: Not in 0.0.1. Before enabling: verify it reads the container's real log path and redacts secrets.

features.name: Infrastructure panel
features.description: Docker containers, images, volumes, networks, stacks, builds, shells and maintenance from the UI.
features.hide_reason: Returns 503 without the Docker socket and is an admin power tool.
features.fix: Not in 0.0.1. Before enabling: require `--coworking`, verify every action on a real host and add confirmations for destructive operations.

features.name: In-app self-update
features.description: Detect and apply a new codx-junior release from inside the app.
features.hide_reason: The installer is the supported update path for 0.0.1.
features.fix: Not in 0.0.1. Before enabling: sign/verify the image, keep a rollback tag and never update without a backup.
